description: Sends a project inquiry or question to the Developh team with the person's own name, email and message. It writes: it creates an inquiry and emails the person a confirmation. The team usually replies by email within 2 to 8 business hours. Requires confirmed=true, which records that the person reviewed the message and asked for it to be sent.

availability.description: When they can take a first call, e.g. weekday mornings, Lisbon time.

company.description: Company or business name, if they gave one.

confirmed.description: Records that the person reviewed the message and asked for it to be sent. Must be true.

email.description: The person's own email address. The confirmation and the reply go here.

locale.description: Answer language: English (en) or European Portuguese (pt).

message.description: What they need, in their words: the project, goals, timeline and budget if known.

name.description: The person's name, as they gave it.

phone.description: Phone number, only if they gave it.

name: request_contact
title: Contact the Developh team
